programme.desc: In an attempt to stem the heroin trade from Iran, a group of narcotics agents working for the UN inject a radioactive compound into a shipment of opium, in the hopes that it will lead them to the main heroin distributor in Europe. Together, they follow the trail as it leads them through the back alleys and luxury resorts of Europe.
